title: Seniors Reached via SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme
what_it_is: Seniors Reached via SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme

sections.label: SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme
sections.summary: The SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme launched in 2021 reached over 14,000 seniors from July to December 2021, targeting 50,000 by 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In 2021, we launched the SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme to raise awareness of cyber threats and encourage adoption of good cyber hygiene among seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: More than 14,000 seniors have attended this programme between July and December 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We target to reach out to 50,000 seniors by 2023.

sections.label: Seniors cyber hygiene curriculum updates
sections.summary: IMDA's SG Digital Office reached over 130,000 seniors, and the programme's curriculum is regularly reviewed, recently adding tips against online scams.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: For example, IMDA's SG Digital Office has reached out to more than 130,000 seniors and the curriculum and the types of interactions can certainly include cyber hygiene practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The curriculum for the SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme is regularly reviewed and updated to ensure its relevance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: For example, with online scams being a growing threat, we have recently included more tips for seniors to guard against online scams.

sections.label: Peer learning for seniors
sections.summary: Peer learning and support is one method that has proven very effective in reaching out to seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In terms of how we reach out to the seniors, one method that has proven to be very effective is peer learning and support.

sections.label: Silver Generation Ambassadors outreach
sections.summary: Outreach will equally be done through the Silver Generation Ambassadors.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As to the involvement of the Silver Generation Ambassadors, yes, the answer is, we will equally reach out through them.
